General & Functional Parameters Specification Parameter Requirement / Allowed Values Product Description Cardiotocography (CTG) Machine Signal Processing capabilities Advanced digital signal processing with AI

Transducer Type Wireless and portable fetal heart monitor Fetal Movement Detection Toco and Maternally sensed fetal movements detected both manually and automatically Twin Monitoring Facility Yes; Simultaneous display of FHR up to twins (FHR1, FHR2) and Toco Heart Rate Offset Mode Visually distinguish twin FHR by offsetting secondary FHR by at least 20 bpm Beat Correspondence Blinking correspondence indicator for each fetal heartbeat Acoustic Stimulator In-built or separate acoustic stimulator featuring a dedicated marker on the graph Trace Interpretation Computerized trace interpretation for antepartum Monitoring of high-risk pregnancies Central Monitoring System Central fetal monitoring system with live multi-patient CTG tracing on a smart TV display & unlimited device connection s must be available. Integrated Hb Device for Hb level understanding in labor room 1. A portable, point-of-care 2 in 1 diagnostic device designed for rapid and accurate measurement of Hem oglobin (Hb) and Blood Glucose using minimal blood volume. 2. Device must operate on nano-technology electrochemical biosensor with constant volume electrochemi cal strip. 3. Suitable for hospital, clinic, and field use. 4. Sensitivity and specificity of more than 90%, Bluetooth connectivity with NST/CTG device, 5. 3V single coin cell battery 6. CDSCO, ISO or IEC approval B. Transducer & Measurement Performance Specification Parameter Requirement / Allowed Values Ultrasound Transducer Equipped with autocorrelation functionality Pulse Doppler Frequency ≤ 1.5 MHz Crystal Design 13 to 15 elements for enhanced signal sensitivity Fetal Heart Rate Range 30 to 240 bpm with a measurement tolerance of ± 1 bpm User Adjustable Alarms Audio-visual alarms for extreme FHR Alarm Threshold Ranges High Alarm: 160 to 180 bpm | Low Alarm: 90 to 120 bpm NST Tracing Mode Auto-timer feature enabled External Toco Transducer Sealed waterproof design with a guard ring to mitigate maternal respirati

on artifact Uterine Tone Sensor Strain gauge sensor element measuring contraction tone Toco Measurement Scope Range: 0 to 100 units | Resolution: ± 1 unit C. Display, Recording & Printing System Display Panel Type Colour screen monitor (TFT / LCD / LED); Flat panel, tillable, and foldabl e Touch Screen Support Yes Display Monitor Size 8 Inches or Higher Patient Data UI Digital display/waveform of tabular and graphical data (Name, ID, Date , Time) for ≥ 24 hours Data Storage / Memory Memory for record storage; Patient data trend graphs stored for 48 to 72 hours In-built Printer System High-resolution Thermal Printer with automatic paper feeding or Can connect to any printer to avoid recurring thermal paper printing an d the reports can be shared on WhatsApp Print Media & Speed Roll Thermosensitive Paper at a selectable real-time trace speed of 3 cm /minute Chart Fast Printing Fast print speed capability for archived FHR and Toco charts D. Electrical, Physical, & Compliance Frameworks Specification Parameter Requirement / Allowed Values Power Infrastructure 220–240 V, 50/60 Hz, AC Single-phase power supply with auto power-off when idle Internal Battery System In-built rechargeable backup battery with a minimum operational capacit y of ≥ 2 hours Physical Mobility Ergonomic trolley with castor wheels, lock mechanics, cover, and probe parking slots Regulatory Certification Absolute compliance with Indian Medical Device Rules (MDR) 2017 ame ndments Android Device Requirement Screen size 8 inches and above Resolution 800x1280 pixels RAM size 4 GB or above Processor 1.4 GHz quad core or above SIM card GSM mobile sim card Micro SD Compatible Internet connectivity 2G/3G/4G, Wi-F The primary bid valuation must comprehensively incorporate all below accessories packed and labelled for sensitive transit:

1. FHR Probes: 2 Units 2. TOCO Probe: 1 Unit 3. Event Marker: 1 Unit 4. Fetal Simulator: 1 Unit 5. Probe Belts: 3 Units 6. Ultrasound Gel: 10 Bottles 7. Power Cable: 1 Unit 8. Print Paper: 20 Packets Thermal Printer roll 9. Software Support: All operating software upgrades must be deployed free of cost during the entir e warranty period. Additional Features 1. The FHRs are wireless 2. The system must have clinical validation from Indian institutions. 3. The alarms are color coded for critical parameters and the volume adjustment should be availabl e with the system 4. The system have a touch screen monitor/display for adjusting the alarms and volume via display i tself 5. The system have heartbeat coincidence alerts. A proof of the same is attached at the time of bidd ing 6. The system must have option of realtime monitoring and remote monitoring 7. In case of battery discharge the system have option of doppler (FHR probe) swap option available . 8. The battery alarm is visible on the doppler as well as on the screen. 9. Gold standard interpretation of parameters accelration as per updated D-R Criteria, decelration, B asal FHR, Fischer Score, STV, LTV 10. The system shows the number and duration of contraction. These parameters are visible on the s creen. 11. The system have option of sharing the reports on WhatsAp/online for specific and editable numbe r. 12. The remote monitoring facility is available with multiple logins. 13. Reports should be sharable via Media or WhatsApp. 14. The system have facility to show report to a doctor from multiple devices. 15. The system follows Dawes-Redmen criteria for high risk pregnancy detection with proven dataset . 16. The system must have heartbeat coincidence alarm 17. Multi-guideline compatibility for auto- interpretation (NICE, FIGO, ACOG, all three guidelines) 18. The system must have a single charging system within the carry case to avoid the entanglement of the charging cables. 19. The system must have robust metal packaging and carry case. 20. The touch screen is protected and theft protection is available within the carry case by/with locki ng system.

21. The system have detachable screen 22. Warranty of the product shall be three years from the date of installation & CAMC cost for the ne xt 7 years must be submitted. 23. The vendor should submit the CE/USFDA /BIS/CDSCO certificate of the product (Model) quoted. 24. The system should have single charging facility to avoid multiple charging points 25. The user manual and service manual in English must be provided. 26. Quality performance certificate from other Hospital must be provided 27. IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-2, EMC and safety testing reports are done via NABL accredited lab shoul d be submitted with the tender 28. The service centre should be placed within 400 km of JIPMER for quick and efficient service of the equipment 29. The supplier must bring the equipment at own expenditure for demonstration on a given date, failing which tender will liable to be rejected 30. The Bidder must submit the document related to the Past performance with 30% of the tender qu antity. 31. Cost break up details of the quoted product should be submitted along with the price bid 32. The performance security paid for the purchase of the equipment will be refunded only after the performance security for the CMC is paid as per the GeM guidelines. 33.
